Anjali says: Rekha spoke fluent English, got a great corporate job, and her husband earns well too.
Anjali says: They go to five-star hotels in Mumbai.
Anjali says: I wanted to work, but I would freeze during interviews because of my broken English.
Anjali says: I had to ask for money even to buy vegetables.
